description: Look up DNS records for a domain (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, SRV, PTR, DNSKEY, DS and more), optionally for one record type.

domain.description: Domain name to look up DNS records for.

type.description: Single record type to return, such as A, MX, or TXT; omit to return all types.

name: lookup_dns
